contract.canonicalization: UTF8 recursively sorted compact JSON; ensure_ascii=false; no floats
contract.document_year_policy: Only explicitly verified physical source pages establish each owner/year. Other packet pages may contain other clients or years and are not approved by this association. Paper-only source years are derived at read time; no native context or figure is fabricated.
contract.identity_basis: 139 visually inspected primary taxpayer identification panels match a unique original full SIN, labeled date of birth and printed native client reference.435 original Info1 anchors freshly redecoded and context/type/length/DCL/CRC verified. The separate2005 summary matches nine original identity anchors and its complete six-page packet was visually reviewed. Names are preserved; exact name equality is not assumed.
contract.transport: Closed hash-allowlisted original documents and descriptors; immutable1MiB chunks and complete original SHA256 verified before committing owner/year links.
